connector.name: Tokonomix Council
connector.registryDescription: Multi-model consensus: 2-6 frontier LLMs answer, an independent judge synthesises one answer.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tokonomix-council-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.tokonomix, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TOKONOMIX_API_KEY
env.description: Tokonomix API key (tok_live_...). Optional - keyless onboarding works without it.
